name: Gruesome Rituals gives Pooled Vitality 1% damage per stack (#740)
contract: Gruesome Rituals 680696 is one effect: aura 107 with MiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, which Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers maps to effect index 1) and BasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = +1, over EffectSpellClassMask (536870912, 0, 0) = word 0 bit 29 = Pooled Vitality 680687 and Running Wild 800175. Pooled Vitality is the class resource for class 20 and its effect 1 is aura 79 MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE with MiscValue 127 (all schools) and value 0, so it becomes 1, and AuraEffect::CalculateAmount multiplies by the stack amount, which is the "for each stack" the tooltip promises. Running Wild's effect 1 is aura 56 TRANSFORM, whose amount the core never reads. Tooltip: "Your damage dealt is now increased by $s1% for each stack of Pooled Vitality." Regression guard for native behaviour.
